We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. Who You Are - 6+ years in network engineering or network-focused IT infrastructure, including owning a multi-site corporate network end to end as the final escalation point - with no senior network engineer above you to hand it to. For the Staff end of the band, ~10+ years and a track record of defining network architecture across a multi-site organization. - Hands-on experience supporting and troubleshooting networking for an Apple-heavy device fleet, including the networking nuances of Apple hardware and macOS. - Deep Cisco Meraki experience at multi-site scale - and you understand what the Dashboard abstracts away. You can design and reason about the routing, segmentation, and RF beneath it, and keep the network running when the abstraction leaks. Fluency with the GUI is assumed, not the job. - Vendor-agnostic command of network fundamentals - you design from first principles, not from templates: L2 / L3 boundaries, IP addressing and subnetting (IPAM), routing including BGP with ISPs, dual-circuit / SD-WAN failover, VLAN segmentation, DNS / DHCP, QoS, and firewall policy - and you troubleshoot at the packet level (e.g. Wireshark) when the dashboard isn’t enough. - Able to walk us through a multi-site network you designed end to end - the trade-offs you made, a failure mode you engineered out, and a cutover or migration you ran without taking the business down. - A standards-setter -

THE ROLE We are looking for a hands-on Staff/Principal Identity Engineer to own Legora's Okta platform and build the security controls that protect our employees, applications, devices and data. This is an individual contributor role with end-to-end responsibility for Okta architecture, engineering, governance and operations. Expert-level Okta capability is the most important requirement. You will set the technical direction, make architecture decisions, build integrations and automation, and remain accountable for how the platform performs in production. You will also engineer controls across SaaS applications, endpoint and device trust, data protection, non-human identities and AI usage. WHAT YOU WILL OWN - Full ownership of Okta: Own the platform roadmap, architecture, configuration, security posture, integrations, change management and operational reliability. Set standards for authentication, authorization, administrative access and recovery. Be the final technical escalation point for complex Okta issues and own their resolution. - Authentication and application integrations: Design and troubleshoot SSO, SAML, OIDC, OAuth and SCIM integrations. Own phishing-resistant MFA, risk-based authentication, session controls and device-aware access policies. Build secure application onboarding with configuration validation, named owners, approvals and controlled secret handling. - Identity lifecycle and access governance: Build reliable joiner, mover and leaver workflows connecting HR systems, Okta, directories and business applications. Own provisioning, entitlement changes and timely revocation, including downstream access and active sessions. Establish access reviews, least-privilege controls, privileged access standards and accountable application ownership. - Identity engineering and automation: Deliver opinionated, practical identity solutions using Python, Okta APIs, Workflows and other appropriate tools. Choose the right mix of infrastructure as code, admin consoles and automation based on risk, scale and maintainability. Keep code in version control with peer
